* Invented airspaces for testing the warnings with the desktop simulator, which starts
* above the Brauneck (47.665 N 11.526 E, 1700 m) heading north. NOT REAL AIRSPACE.
*
* A control zone whose southern edge lies about 590 m north of the start.
AC D
AY CTR
AN TEST CTR Brauneck
AL GND
AH 7000ft MSL
DP 47:40:15 N 011:28:00 E
DP 47:40:15 N 011:36:00 E
DP 47:45:00 N 011:36:00 E
DP 47:45:00 N 011:28:00 E

* A TMA above the start with its base at FL65 (1981 m pressure altitude), to warn when
* climbing in the simulated thermals.
